title: fix(objectql)!: an object_extension amount naming a sibling currencyField the served object does not hold is refused at the save
body:
Fixes #33911
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` already says a record-mode amount's code lives in the `text` field `currencyField` names, declaring `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'`, with no carve-out for an extension; the refusal now makes that true for an extension's amount, and its text carries the prescription

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:管理员或 AI 给已有对象加扩展字段时,若金额字段的币种字段指向一个不存在或不存币种代码的字段,保存时就直接被拒(422),并列出可用的币种字段;以前保存成功,之后每次写该金额都失败。
- 为什么做:属于多币种金额(按记录币种)这一族的收口,补上扩展对象这条漏判的保存入口,与普通对象的保存判定一致。
- 出错会怎样:只影响新保存或新安装的扩展;已装好的包照常启动,不被追溯拒绝;撤回本改动即恢复原行为。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

- `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`: the follow door (`recordCurrencyFollowRefusal`) gains pair (b): a record-mode amount whose `currencyField` is ONE segment is judged against the object AS SERVED (owner, every enabled extension, and the incoming body in its slot). A pointer naming no other field, or a field that is not a code field (`isRecordCurrencyCodeField`), is refused `RecordCurrencyFollowRefusedError` (`INVALID_METADATA` / 422), naming the amount, the pointer and the served object's code-field candidates. An amount an extension adds is also named with its package when an owner re-registration is what breaks it (R6's wording). The R7 `before` comparison applies unchanged, and only to an install, upgrade or reload run: such a run is not refused over a pair it leaves as it found it. A single save and the batch writers judge with the slot left empty (`judgeRegistrationDoors` passes `before: null`). So re-publishing an unchanged extension whose pointer a cold boot admitted is refused, and so is a published save of the owner while an extension's amount dangles; the fix is to correct or uninstall the extension, then save the owner again.
- No caller change was needed: `protocol-save.ts`'s `object_extension` branch already asks `objectRegistrationRefusal(..., { againstRegistry: true })`, which reaches this door with the served fold.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.record-currency-sibling-extension-judged-as-served.ts`: the ADR-0087 semantic entry the narrowing owes (`check:adr-0087-registration` refuses `no-migration-prescription` on a `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` changeset). Its `reason` states the run-only R7 comparison and the single-save behaviour above, and its `replacement` gives the unchanged-owner prescription, following `record-currency-follow-extension-judged-as-served`. This file is OUTSIDE the claim's declared file surface; see Acceptance notes.
- `.changeset/33911-extension-sibling-currency-field.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` minor, the two declaration lines, `Skills-docs:`, and the `registered` disposition.
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` is untouched: the schema carve-out for extensions stays.

Read first (by risk):
1. `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`, the new `(b)` loop inside `followRefusalsOf`: it runs for every layer the follow door judges, not only extensions, so an owner layer is judged too (an own body already passed the spec's sibling refusal, so only a field another layer removes can trip it).
2. `recordCurrencySiblingCodeError` in the same file: the refusal sentence.
3. The new describe at the end of `protocol-batch-object-registration.test.ts`, and the new sibling-pair describe in `manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol-batch-object-registration.test.ts src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts` — expect `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 84 passed (84)`.

## Tests

New top-level describe in `packages/objectql/src/protocol-batch-object-registration.test.ts` (real kernel, real `SchemaRegistry`, real protocol `saveMetaItem` on the `meta-envelope` face in `publish` mode — the face `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/NAME` uses):

- refused: a pointer naming no field of the served object answers `status: 422`, `code: 'INVALID_METADATA'`, names `'zz_missing'` and `candidates: 'currency_code'`, and stores no row and registers no field;
- refused: a pointer naming a served `text` field without the value domain;
- refused: the served object holds no code field (the message says so);
- served CONTROL: a pointer naming the owner's `currency_code` saves and is served;
- served CONTROL: a pointer naming a code field the same extension body adds, or another registered extension adds, saves;
- owner end: the owner re-registering without the code field a registered extension's amount names is refused, naming that package;
- single save over a pointer already dangling: an unchanged re-publish of the extension through protocol `saveMetaItem` answers 422 `INVALID_METADATA` (`RecordCurrencyFollowRefusedError`) and stores nothing. The owner's unchanged body is refused at the registry seam the save asks (`objectRegistrationRefusal`, own layer, `againstRegistry: true`). Through the protocol save, the destructive-change door answers 409 first, because it reads the extension's column as one the owner's body would drop. That is filed separately as a measure-first card.

New top-level describe in `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts` (`manifest.register` runs), next to pair (a)'s run-level cases:

- refused: an extension-only install naming `'zz_missing'` answers 422 with the candidates;
- install CONTROL: a satisfiable pointer installs;
- R7: no-change upgrades of the owner and the extension over a dangling pointer a cold boot admitted both install;
- R6: an owner upgrade that drops the code field is refused, naming the extension's package.

Premise re-measured first, on unmodified `origin/main` 895dd437 (pins committed alone as 12f52fa5): the three refused cases and the owner case failed (`expected undefined to match object { status: 422, ... }`: the save resolved, i.e. 200), the two controls passed.

Ablation (once, committed head c4d3d829, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the suite imports the door from `src/` by relative path, so no dist rebuild is in the path): the sibling judge's message forced to `undefined` (anchor 1 -> 0, blob 564929038d45 -> f520e509f87f) turned exactly the four refusal cases red (`Tests 4 failed | 24 passed (28)`); restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. Round 2: the R7 comparison ablated (`if (!already.has(pair)) return refusal;` → `void already; return refusal;`, blob 564929038d45 → 3cd8063dcc73) turned only the R7 pin red (`Tests 1 failed | 3 passed | 51 skipped`); restored to blob == HEAD.

<details><summary>Package runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`) then `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 616 passed (616)`, `Tests 13911 passed (13911)` on `61d6e23b`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 947 passed (947)`, `Tests 28948 passed | 1 todo (28949)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- File-surface extension: the claim named the door, its `protocol-save.ts` caller, tests and one changeset. A `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` changeset cannot carry `no-migration-prescription` (`check:adr-0087-registration`), so the narrowing owes a `registered` semantic entry, which lives in `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`. That one new file is the only path outside the surface; it adds no schema key or export, and the changeset bumps `@objectstack/objectql` alone, as `.changeset/34864-seed-unknown-object-save-door.md` does for its entry.
- The door judges the one-segment pointer at every layer, so an owner re-registration that drops the code field an extension's amount names is refused too (R6's shape for the sibling form). A cold boot is not asked, as before.
- A two-segment pointer on an extension whose first segment is not a `master_detail` of the served object is still not judged by this door (`path.master === undefined` stays skipped, as on main). Filed as #35562. Per-item publish of an `object_extension` draft is filed as #35566.
- Round 2 adds `manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts`, a test of the door inside the claim's "their tests". L2 records: 7013686819 (`b64d1bdf`, S1/S2 open) and the delta 7015428256 (`61d6e23b`, PASS, S1/S2 closed).

## Verification

The derived gate list below was run on `b64d1bdf`; round 2 re-derived the same 91 commands on `61d6e23b` and re-ran the ADR-0087, upgrade-guide, spec-changes, changeset and prose gates (all exit 0). `overlap-check`: merges cleanly.

- Dogfood battery on the final head `61d6e23b` (the claim carries `(narrowing)`), and earlier on `b64d1bdf` with the same counts: `--filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, `Test Files 482 passed | 3 skipped (485)`, `Tests 4092 passed | 68 skipped (4160)`.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 91): first pass 87 exit 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: unbuilt dist) and the cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance` test exit 1 (MODULE_NOT_FOUND: unbuilt `@objectstack/mcp`), each re-run after the dogfood closure build: exit 0, exit 0, `Tests 3 passed (3)`. `--ran` reconciliation of the first pass: 91 accounted, 88 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (the exit 3 rows).
- NOT MEASURED: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3, its pinned positive control is unreachable in this shallow clone; checker-health only, CI runs it).
- `check:adr-0087-registration`: `1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition ... registered record-currency-sibling-extension-judged-as-served (new here)`. `check:upgrade-guide` and `check:spec-changes` generate green. `check:nul-bytes` OK.
- `test:repo` not run locally (no diff in that project; CI `Test Core` runs it). Every other CI family: read from this PR's check-runs.
